offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures asphalt mixing plants and related equipment, including combustion systems and emissions control equipment. Sells to road construction contractors, asphalt producers and government-related buyers. Also supplies replacement parts.

primary_products.value: hot-mix asphalt plants; asphalt drum mixers; combustion systems and burners; pollution control equipment; replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2B: asphalt producers, paving and road construction contractors, industrial users; B2G: government agencies and municipalities buying plants for road building

end_markets.value: road construction; infrastructure; asphalt production; industrial heating

revenue_model.value: product sales: asphalt plants, combustion systems and control equipment; product sales: replacement parts and aftermarket components

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: builds asphalt plants and combustion systems from steel and purchased components, sold to contractors and producers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Latin America, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: asphalt plants, combustion systems and emissions control equipment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to contractors and producers; distributors / dealers: international dealers and sales representatives

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: air emissions standards (EPA) apply to equipment, workplace safety and export rules
